text.tspan: Based on the expert assessments and index by V-Dem, weighted by countries' populations. It captures the extent to which people are free
from forced labor, have property rights, and enjoy the freedoms of movement and religion. The variables ranges from 0 to 1 (most liberties).
Data source: OWID based on V-Dem (v13); Gapminder (v6); HYDE (v3.2); UN (2022)
